description: Portable, opt-in Studio application preset templates. Templates install as data under ~/.config/hornero/studio-presets; applying one to an application is always an explicit, create-if-absent copy that never overwrites user configuration.

presets.title: OBS Studio recording baseline
presets.description: 1080p30 canvas/output with MKV recording. No stream key, no account data, no hardcoded bitrate: encoder and bitrate stay with OBS defaults and your hardware.
